selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity and rule out look-alike objects (e.g., cricket ball, softball) based on fine-grained features like stitch count and size relative to texture.
To verify that the red stitching is topologically connected to the leather surface and does not exhibit 'floating' artifacts or bleeding into the white background, which is common in AI generations.
The image contains visible black text/logos. AI models often fail to render coherent text, producing gibberish. This expert will verify legibility and structural integrity of the characters.
To perform a holistic check for subtle texture anomalies, noise patterns, or lighting inconsistencies that might indicate generative origins despite good geometry.
